newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SHIPPING COMPANY TO BOOST SHARE CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: SHIPPING COMPANY TO BOOST SHARE CAPITAL.

text.p: The Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company said on Friday that it planned to use part of its 1996 profit to boost its share capital.

"The shareholders' meeting on Thursday decided to use 16.5 million litas from our 1996 net profit to increase our share capital from 471 million litas to 487.5 million litas," Arvydas Stropus, the head of the company's economy department, told Reuters by telephone.
The company earlier reported that its 1996 net profit had fallen to 55.8 million litas from 67.7 million litas in 1995.
The company is the largest transport firm in Lithuania with a turnover of 310.5 million litas in 1996 compared with 295.4 million litas the previous year,
It has a fleet of 40 ships and has been slated for privatisation.
